name: bm25-scoring-mechanics
explain: Implement Okapi BM25 scoring from first principles. Explains how parameter k1 controls term frequency saturation and parameter b penalizes long documents, preventing keyword stuffing anomalies.
steps: Compute term frequency, document frequency, and inverse document frequency (IDF) across a sample corpus. || Score query terms using document length normalization to prevent verbose documents from dominating results.

name: hnsw-graph-navigation
explain: Demonstrate Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) multi-layer graph navigation. Traverses sparse long-range express layers down to the dense base layer in O(log N) greedy hops.
steps: Start greedy nearest-neighbor walk from entry point at top sparse expressway layer. || Descend down hierarchical layers to identify nearest neighbor in the dense base layer.
expect: HNSW search verified: target=(8.8, 8.9), nearest=N4, navigation_path=[(2, 'N3'), (1, 'N4'), (0, 'N4')]

name: pre-filtering-vs-post-filtering
explain: Demonstrate candidate starvation in vector post-filtering vs single-stage pre-filtering. Post-filtering global nearest neighbors drops valid tenant documents; pre-filtering constrains graph traversal to admissible predicates.
steps: Execute post-filtering and demonstrate candidate starvation returning 0 matching results. || Execute pre-filtered vector search and verify all matching tenant documents are recalled.

name: hybrid-dense-sparse-fusion
explain: Implement Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combining Dense semantic embeddings and Sparse lexical (BM25) rankings. Smooths ranking discrepancies and catches both exact code tokens and conceptual synonyms.
steps: Retrieve candidate rankings from dense semantic and sparse lexical retrieval stages. || Compute RRF score 1/(k + rank) for each candidate and sort by fused consensus score.
expect: RRF Hybrid Fusion verified: top_doc=doc_A, score=0.03226, rankings=[('doc_A', 0.03226), ('doc_B', 0.03226), ('doc_C', 0.01613), ('doc_D', 0.01613)]

name: bi-encoder-vs-cross-encoder
explain: Compare Bi-Encoder fast candidate retrieval with Cross-Encoder joint-attention reranking. Bi-encoders retrieve initial candidates via fast dot products; cross-encoders evaluate query-document token cross-attention to resolve semantic negations.
steps: Retrieve top candidate pool using bi-encoder vector similarity. || Rerank candidates with cross-encoder joint attention to correct semantic negation misclassifications.

name: contextual-query-rewriting
explain: Rewrite multi-turn conversational queries by resolving coreferences and pronouns with conversation history, protected by deduplication and entity boundary guards.
steps: Detect conversational follow-up pronouns and resolve subjects from prior user and assistant turns. || Bound the number of query variants and preserve exact entity identifiers.
expect: Contextual rewriting verified: original='What about in the UK?', rewrites=['What about in the UK?', 'What about in the UK for the Enterprise Plan?']

name: retrieval-offline-metrics
explain: Implement offline retrieval evaluation metrics from scratch: Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@k), Mean Average Precision (MAP), and Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain (NDCG@k).
steps: Compute reciprocal rank of the first relevant document hit. || Calculate average precision and discounted cumulative gain against graded ground-truth relevance judgments.
expect: Retrieval offline evaluation verified: MRR@5=0.5, MAP@5=0.5, NDCG@5=0.883

name: typed-retrieval-pipeline
explain: Enforce typed retrieval contracts, candidate budget bounds, and metric directionality. Normalizes cosine similarity and L2 Euclidean distance into monotonic relevance thresholds.
steps: Validate candidate_k, final_k, and mandatory tenant filter boundaries before query execution. || Convert L2 distance and cosine similarity into normalized [0, 1] relevance scores.
expect: Typed retrieval request validated: query='enterprise SSO SAML configuration', tenant=tenant_acme, candidate_k=40, final_k=5

name: parallel-hybrid-retrieval
explain: Execute dense vector and sparse lexical retrieval concurrently using asyncio.gather with independent timeouts and graceful degradation.
steps: Dispatch dense and sparse search coroutines concurrently to minimize user-visible latency. || Merge retrieved results preserving candidate provenance and degrading gracefully if a provider times out.
expect: Parallel hybrid retrieval completed: dense=2, lexical=2, total_unique=3

name: candidate-pool-sizing
explain: Analyze candidate pool sizing failure modes. Undersized candidate pools cause starvation by excluding decisive edge cases from downstream rerankers; calibrated pools recover decisive evidence.
steps: Demonstrate that candidate_k=5 truncates a decisive exception ranked #8 in vector similarity. || Expand candidate_k=30, allowing the cross-encoder reranker to promote the decisive evidence to rank 1.
expect: Candidate pool sizing verified: candidate_k=5 failed (starvation); candidate_k=30 recovered decisive evidence to rank 1
